data.one_liner: Geodesy and geographic calculations for Dart, offering LatLong and Mercator projection.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes for latitude/longitude handling, coordinate system conversions (ECI/ECF, WGS84/72), Julian date utilities, ground‑track and tile‑index projections. All calculations are pure Dart with no external dependencies.
use_when: You need to perform geodetic calculations such as coordinate conversions or distance/angle computations in a Dart/Flutter app.
You require a lightweight, dependency‑free library for handling lat/long, Julian dates, or projection to map tiles.
avoid_when: You need full‑featured map widgets or UI components for displaying maps.
You require platform‑specific geolocation services or real‑time tracking that need native plugins.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with no external dependencies
Supports a wide range of geodesy calculations (ECI/ECF, Julian dates, ground track)
Simple API and easy to import
weaknesses: No UI or map rendering capabilities
Limited to calculation utilities; no networking or storage features
Documentation is minimal beyond basic README
